answer:
Implemented automatic ledger retries.

- Added [`LedgerRetryJob.java`](/home/garry/code/experiments/2026-11-okf-context/results/pilot/feat-B/work/F5/B/codex/1/src/main/java/com/example/accounts/payment/LedgerRetryJob.java), scheduled every 15 minutes.
- Retries `POSTING_FAILED` payments up to 3 times.
- Reuses the original ledger reference and marks successful retries `COMPLETED`.
- Persists retry counts on [`Payment.java`](/home/garry/code/experiments/2026-11-okf-context/results/pilot/feat-B/work/F5/B/codex/1/src/main/java/com/example/accounts/payment/Payment.java).
- Verified with `mvn -o -q test` — all tests pass.
